title: DuckX's Vanilla++
body:
## 📖 Overview

**DuckX's Vanilla++** is a carefully curated vanilla+ modpack that enhances the core Minecraft experience without changing what makes it special.

Instead of overhauling the game, this pack focuses on subtle, meaningful improvements — making the world feel more immersive, alive, and enjoyable while keeping everything true to vanilla.

From ambient world details and visual upgrades to quality of life improvements and light gameplay additions, every feature is designed to feel natural and cohesive.

**💡 It’s still Minecraft — just smoother, richer, and more immersive.**

## ⚙️ Key Features:

- 🌿 Vanilla-friendly enhancements
- 🧭 Improved exploration & world immersion
- 🌎 More ambient details and environmental depth
- 🪵 Expanded building & decoration options
- ⚙️ Quality of life improvements
- 💡 Subtle gameplay additions that fit naturally

## 🎯 Gameplay Focus

- 🌿 Vanilla+ experience
- 🧭 Exploration and discovery
- 🏡 Cozy building and creativity
- 🌎 Living, dynamic environments
- ⚙️ Smooth, intuitive gameplay

## ⭐ Why this modpack?

- 🌿 **True vanilla feel** — no unnecessary overhauls  
- ⚖️ **Carefully balanced additions** that fit Minecraft naturally  
- 🌎 **More immersive world** with small but impactful details  
- ⚙️ **Improved gameplay flow** without added complexity  
- 💚 **Perfect for long-term survival worlds**

## ⚠️ Requirements

- 🧠 Recommended: 4–6 GB RAM  
- 💻 Lightweight and performance-friendly  
- 🎮 Great for singleplayer & casual multiplayer  

## 📈 Progression

Enjoy a natural Minecraft progression enhanced with subtle improvements — explore richer environments, build more detailed structures, and experience a world that feels more alive without changing the core gameplay loop.
